name: @knowget/library
description: Knowledge Resource, Library & Digital Learning Asset Platform (P2-D18) — the institution's knowledge-resource system of record: the bibliographic catalog (titles) and its physical copies, digital learning assets, library members (borrowers), the loans and reservations through which resources circulate, the circulation policy that governs them, and a descriptive collection profile. A pure availability engine derives a title's availability and the collection rollup; a pure loan-status engine derives due dates, overdue days and renewals. Money (library fines, acquisition cost) is out of scope — deferred to Finance (P2-D14) and Procurement/Assets (P2-D15).
